page.layout: One column of index entries, running down the page, with page references at the right. A letter heading "C." sits centred in the middle. No margins, no notes, no catchword. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: Celloti, Jesuitae liber de Hierarchia & Hierar-chis. 446
Columbae sub figura Semiramis culta. ibid
Congregatio Presbyterorum Oratorii in Gal-lia. 2.[?] seqq

page.notes: Top-right page mark is unclear; read as iii[?]. The M before "qvomodo" is a large initial glyph, read as M[?]. "228.feq.247" and "2. feqq" are printed with the long-s form of "seq"; given as seq. The "2" in "2. seqq" is doubtful. The last line is cut off at the foot of the scan ("ejus-" continues on the next page). The "1" in "Bloesia" and the "151" in "Characterum" are set on a separate line in the original, read as printed.
